title: Location filter defaults to the user's active location on first load
custom_preconds:
1. Your browser has no saved view for this report.
2. You are working in a known active location (check the application's location switcher).
custom_steps:
1. Open the Sales By Customer report.
2. Read the location filter's current selection.
custom_expected: 1. The filter defaults to the single location you are currently working in (your active location) — not all locations.
